tool-call.eventDescription: A successful Figma data or SVG call: get_figma_component, get_figma_file, export_svg, or one exported icon in migrate_all_svgs. Failed calls are free.

render.eventDescription: A successful render_node_png: Figma renders the node and the PNG is returned. Failed calls are free.

verify.eventDescription: A successful verify_render: your HTML is rendered in headless Chromium and compared with the Figma design (SSIM, pixel diff, diff regions, diff image). Failed calls are free.
